svg.title: Wentao He
svg.desc: A terminal types whoami, then Wentao He, then // Engineering Lead, Multimodal @ Mercor, which it deletes and retypes as // engineer · developer · photographer · powerlifter, and back; JetBrains Mono, a blinking cursor, falling code symbols behind.
